title: [UX] "Add treatment" shortcut on graph
body:
There is a "Add note" button when we click on a graph.

My idea is to add a treatment shortcut with the time value prefilled with the one of the plot we clicked on the graph.

I tend to enter carbs late, when we forget to log one I tend to click on the graph to add the missing one.

It seam that ppl may tend intuitively to click on the graph and add note instead of adding treatment (maybe because of others software that only support text)

Another suggestion is to parse entered note and if someone entered units (carbs or others keywords) as note, poping an infobox asking if the user meant to enter a treatment

To unclutter the UI we can maybe use pictograms on the footer, instead of text (not sure if it'll help or confuse ppl)
